part: main loop: per-key triage of the engine's 328 questions
question: What share of the engine's 328 yes/no questions could the CPU answer when sure, key by key, against Clef's answers on 2,488 stories?
one_change: run the answer-when-sure rule once per engine key with at least 10 positives instead of only the 15 keys with at least 200

baseline.model: answer-when-sure on the 15 attributes with at least 200 positives, mean coverage

prediction.metric: engine_share_answered_conservative: sum of per-key coverage over keys with at least 10 positives, divided by all 328 keys (untested keys count as not answered)
prediction.why: a 5-key smoke run gave coverage 0.47 on the one key with 30 or more positives and 0.21 on the four keys with 10 to 29; 125 keys have 30 or more positives and 107 have 10 to 29, so about (125 x 0.4 + 107 x 0.2) / 328 is 0.22, and 96 keys with under 10 positives are counted as zero
